independent_check.source_and_assumptions: Read printed physical pp.6-8 Tables 1,3,6 and their claimed deltas; differences refer to displayed final table values, not independently authenticated experiment outputs.
independent_check.decisive_check: Table 3 CLIP T2I differences are (30.2-24.7,50.3-45.1,60.5-54.6)=(5.5,5.2,5.9). The prose endpoint (39.3,61.5,71.8) is the Long-CLIP+GMAIL row. Its cross-backbone difference is (14.6,16.4,17.2), so the prose 16.0 is additionally not the cross-row arithmetic. Table 6 differences are (1.97,1.35,4.18,.80,1.15,1.08). Table 1 Llama3 first four differences are (2.85,3.38,10.40,4.23).
independent_check.counterevidence: All displayed improvements remain positive. Stale prose or tables from another run could explain the disagreement but does not make the published statements internally consistent. A 0.01 WMD difference can be influenced by hidden precision; the much larger B@4, METEOR and backbone mismatches cannot all be rounding.
independent_check.dependency_severity_repair: Minor local magnitude/backbone attribution errors; no raw-run refutation follows. Regenerate narratives from the identified final outputs and matched baseline rows. The report was refined to state explicitly that the R@5 cross-row calculation is 16.4, not 16.0.
independent_check.unresolved_report_items: Source p.4 says real encoder unchanged, then explicitly mentions a LoRA-finetuned encoder; p.13 says both real/generated projections are trained; Algorithm 1 p.14 updates fg and infers with fr. Thus identical fixed score branches would imply unchanged retrieval, but trained real projections are an explicit alternative and the gains are not proved impossible. Both real/generated downstream embeddings are declared in Algorithm 1, and raw WMD transformation remains unspecified. These remain Needs Evidence, not leakage or reversed-metric findings.

checked_claims: Conditional invariance of unchanged real/text scoring branches
All numbered figures and applicable appendix controls
repair_verification: Displayed-table differences and matched-backbone comparison corrected analytically; raw outputs and author implementation unavailable.
